This is Mess Monster, a React Native/Expo virtual pet app.
Stack: Expo ~54.0, React Native 0.81.5, TypeScript 5.9, Zustand 5.0 with AsyncStorage, Expo Router 6.0.

Completed: all 7 Zustand stores, evolution system, task system, timer rewards, UI components, navigation, decay system.

Still needed: onboarding.tsx implementation, real IAP wiring, notifications for decay reminders.
